description: This file defines Kubernetes API server internal storage version types, including StorageVersion, StorageVersionStatus, ServerStorageVersion, and related constants and conditions.

classes.name: StorageVersion
classes.description: Represents the storage version of a specific resource in Kubernetes.

classes.name: StorageVersionSpec
classes.description: An empty spec for StorageVersion, included for API style compliance.

classes.name: StorageVersionStatus
classes.description: Reports the versions a server can decode and encode, and overall storage version state.

classes.name: ServerStorageVersion
classes.description: Details the encoding and decoding versions reported by an API server instance.

classes.name: StorageVersionCondition
classes.description: Describes the state of the storage version at a specific point in time.
